invariants.description: No resource is reported twice by the same check
Every finding belongs to a check in the catalogue
Every finding comes from a check that ran
Finding counts per check match the coverage table
Severity is one of info, low, medium, high
Each finding's fingerprint recomputes from its content
Every finding names a resource and has a message
No certainty wording in finding text (language lint)
No check reports as ran when a collector it needs had an error
Every finding carries an evidence trail (rule version and data digests)

audit.limits: Consistency checks only. They do not show that findings are true; precision needs the human sampling audit (docs/AUDIT.md layer C).
